metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAM 2D Toolpath Parameters - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Comprehensive parameter catalog for all Fusion 360 2D milling toolpath operations
metadata.source: Autodesk Fusion 360 Help Documentation, CAD/CAM Lessons tutorials

commonTabs.description: Standard tabs shared across most 2D toolpath operations

2D_ADAPTIVE_CLEARING.description: High-efficiency roughing strategy with constant tool engagement and optimal load control

parameters.name: Lead-In Feedrate
parameters.description: Feed when entering a cutting move

parameters.name: Lead-Out Feedrate
parameters.description: Feed when exiting a cutting move

parameters.name: Machining Boundary
parameters.description: Select pocket contour, face, edge or sketch

parameters.name: Stock Contours
parameters.description: Consider defined stock or selected boundary

parameters.name: Rest Machining
parameters.description: Machine only areas previous tools couldn't reach

parameters.name: Rest Material Tool Diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of previous tool for rest machining

parameters.name: Tool Orientation
parameters.description: Set X, Y, Z triad axis orientation

parameters.name: Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum chord distance when linearizing geometry

parameters.name: Optimal Load
parameters.description: Maximum radial engagement as percentage of tool diameter

parameters.name: Use Slot Clearing
parameters.description: Enable specialized clearing for narrow pockets/grooves

parameters.name: Slot Clearing Width
parameters.description: Width of groove machined first when slot clearing enabled

parameters.name: Both Ways
parameters.description: Use both climb and conventional milling

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: Smooth toolpath by fitting arcs and removing points

parameters.name: Order by Depth
parameters.description: Order cuts by Z level across multiple contours

parameters.name: Maximum Ramp Stepdown
parameters.description: Maximum stepdown per revolution on ramp

parameters.name: Ramp Clearance Height
parameters.description: Height above stock for helix start

2D_CONTOUR.description: Profile milling along edges and contours with optional roughing and finishing passes

parameters.name: Contour Selection
parameters.description: Select faces, edges or sketches for machining boundary

parameters.name: Tangential Extension Distance
parameters.description: Extend toolpath tangentially at start and end

parameters.name: Rest Machining
parameters.description: Machine only rest material from previous operation

parameters.name: Leads on all Finishing Passes
parameters.description: Full lead in/out on every pass

parameters.name: Use Thin Wall
parameters.description: Machine both sides of thin walls

parameters.name: Reduced Feed Distance
parameters.description: Distance to reduce feed before corner

parameters.name: Only Inner Corners
parameters.description: Reduce feed only at inner corners

2D_POCKET.description: Clear material from enclosed pockets with multiple passes and finishing options

parameters.name: Pocket Selection
parameters.description: Select pocket faces, edges or sketches

FACE.description: Level the top surface of stock material with facing passes

SLOT.description: Machine slots following the centerline with end mill engagement

parameters.name: Pocket Selection
parameters.description: Select slot bottom edges or sketches

TRACE.description: Machine along contours with varying Z values, with or without compensation

parameters.name: Trace Contours
parameters.description: Select edges, curves or sketches to trace

parameters.name: Axial Offset
parameters.description: Offset below surface (negative to cut into material)

ENGRAVE.description: Machine along contours with V-shaped chamfered walls for text and logos

BORE.description: Helical bore milling for cylindrical pockets and holes larger than tool diameter

parameters.name: Hole Selection
parameters.description: Select cylindrical faces or circular edges

parameters.name: Lead to Center
parameters.description: Lead to hole center before spiral

CIRCULAR.description: Circular interpolation for cylindrical pockets and islands with discrete Z-levels

THREAD.description: Thread milling for internal and external threads

parameters.name: Thread Selection
parameters.description: Select cylindrical faces or thread features

parameters.name: Pitch Diameter Offset
parameters.description: Offset from major to minor diameter

2D_CHAMFER.description: Chamfer edges using chamfer mills or V-bits

parameters.name: Auto-Detect Chamferable Edges
parameters.description: Automatically find chamfer edges on full contour

parameters.name: Chamfer Width
parameters.description: Width of chamfer (size from side view)

parameters.name: Chamfer Tip Offset
parameters.description: Additional depth for tool tip (prevents tip damage)

Geometry.description: Boundary selection, rest machining, tabs, orientation

Heights.description: Z-level definitions for clearance, retract, feed, top, bottom

Passes.description: Cutting strategy, stepover, stepdown, finishing, stock allowance
